igbo: Okpukpe bụ akụkụ nke ndụ ọtụtụ mmadụ.
english: Religion is part of the lives of many people.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ nwere nkwenkwe dị iche iche.
Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-ekpe ekpere kwa ụbọchị.
Ọ na-aga ebe ofufe kwa izu.
english: He goes to a place of worship every week.

igbo: Ebe ofufe ahụ dị nso n'ụlọ ya.
english: The place of worship is near his house.
People gather at the place of worship.
The priest leads the worship service.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ gere ozi ọma ahụ ntị.
Ekpere dị mkpa nye ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ.
english: Prayer is important to many people.

igbo: Ha na-ekpe ekpere maka ezinụlọ ha.
Nne na-ekpe ekpere maka ụmụ ya.
english: The mother prays for her children.

igbo: Nna ahụ na-ekpe ekpere kwa ụtụtụ.
Ụmụaka na-ekpe ekpere tupu ha erie nri.
english: The children pray before they eat.
They thanked God for the food.
Hope is important during difficult times.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ na-enweta nkasi obi site n'okpukpe.
Ọ dị mkpa ịkwanyere ndị ọzọ ùgwù.
english: It is important to respect others.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ kwesịrị inyere ibe ha aka.
Ịhụnanya na-eme ka ndị mmadụ dịrị n'otu.
Obodo ahụ nwere ọtụtụ ebe ofufe.
english: The town has many places of worship.
People go to worship in the morning.
The worship service started on time.
The worship service lasted one hour.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ bụrụ abụ n'oge ofufe.
english: People sang during the worship service.

igbo: Onye nduzi gụrụ akụkụ akwụkwọ nsọ.
english: The leader read a passage from the holy book.

igbo: Ndị nne na nna na-akụziri ụmụ ha nkwenkwe ha.
english: Parents teach their children their beliefs.
The family goes to worship together.
Friends met at the place of worship.
Members of the community support one another.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ nyere onye ọrịa aka.

english: They gave money to the poor.

igbo: Ọ na-enyere ndị ọzọ aka mgbe niile.
Obiọma dị mkpa n'etiti ndị mmadụ.

english: It is important to learn to forgive.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ na-echeta ụbọchị pụrụ iche.
Ndị mmadụ yi uwe mara mma maka emume.
english: People wore beautiful clothes for the celebration.

igbo: Ha kwadebere nri maka ndị ọbịa.
english: They prepared food for the visitors.

igbo: Ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ bịara emume ahụ.
english: Many people came to the celebration.
The celebration took place at home.

igbo: Ịdị umeala n'obi bụ omume ọma.

english: Peace is important in a community.

igbo: Ọ dị mkpa ibi ndụ n'udo.
english: It is important to live in peace.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ na-akwanyere nkwenkwe ibe ha ùgwù.
Anyị kwesịrị ịkwanyere ndị nwere nkwenkwe dị iche ùgwù.
english: We should respect people with different beliefs.

igbo: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-achọ ndụ dị mma.
english: Many people seek a good life.

igbo: Ọ na-enweta ume site n'okpukpe ya.
english: He gains strength from his religion.

igbo: Ndị enyi ya na-enye ya ndụmọdụ.
Ọ na-enweta nkasi obi n'oge nsogbu.
english: He finds comfort during difficult times.

igbo: Olileanya na-enyere mmadụ aka ịga n'ihu.
english: Hope helps a person move forward.

igbo: Ịhụnanya na obiọma na-eme ka ụwa ka mma.
english: Love and kindness make the world better.

igbo: Ndị mmadụ kwesịrị ibi ndụ n'ịhụnanya na udo.
english: People should live in love and peace.

igbo: Ezi omume na-enyere mmadụ na obodo aka.
english: Good behavior helps both the individual and the community.
